subject.title: [Feature]: Per-user heartbeat routing for channel-level heartbeat messages

question: Should WhatsApp/channel heartbeat visibility grow an OK-only recipient config, and if so should the contract be `target`, `targets`, or a different per-account shape?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear in source, but adding a new channel config surface affects compatibility, docs, validation, and recipient semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Define Additive OK Recipients
options.body: Add a backwards-compatible WhatsApp heartbeat recipient shape for OK acknowledgments only, with account precedence and allowlist validation.

options.title: Reject Channel OK Recipients
options.body: Keep heartbeat routing on the existing agent-level `target` and `to` fields and avoid adding another channel config surface.

options.title: Defer To Cross-Channel Routing
options.body: Leave this open under a broader channel heartbeat routing design if maintainers want one contract across WhatsApp and other channels.

recommendation.title: Define Additive OK Recipients
recommendation.body: Add a backwards-compatible WhatsApp heartbeat recipient shape for OK acknowledgments only, with account precedence and allowlist validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across the shared WhatsApp schema and heartbeat delivery routing paths.
